signature: “MICHAEL HAINLEIN NVRNBERG 1691” [master’s mark: initials "M H" and cock's head.
remarks: 2 tubular slide stays, lower one telescopic; slide stays have typical Nuremberg floral / leaf pattern. Ferrules adjacent to slide stays have scale pattern, those at slide bow have ring pattern. Solder repair at slide bow; saddle and ring at slide bow, with zigzag pattern on saddle, which is partly obliterated by solder repair. Flat bell stay with typical Nuremberg floral decoration; hinge and pin. Bellpipe has pommel (28mm) with Turk’s-cap ridges, beginning 215 from bell end; bell bow has saddle (with zigzag pattern) and ring. Garland has shell pattern at proximal border. Nuremberg-style rim wire has floral / leaf pattern. Examined by the author, August 2002.
